top_stories.title: OpenAI cuts off Cursor after SpaceX acquisition, citing Musk's history of breaking contracts
top_stories.description: OpenAI is cutting off the AI coding tool Cursor after SpaceX acquired the company, citing Elon Musk's track record of breaking contracts. Cursor co-founder Michael Truell downplays the move, saying OpenAI models account for just five percent of the tool's AI traffic. The article OpenAI cuts off Cursor after SpaceX acquisition, citing Musk's history of breaking contracts appeared first on The Decoder.

top_stories.title: Nvidia to buy AI platform Hugging Face for $12.9 billion: Report

top_stories.title: AI searched 100 million possibilities and found a cheaper way to 3D-print a NASA rocket alloy
top_stories.description: Researchers used AI to search through more than 100 million possible settings for 3D-printing a high-performance NASA alloy. After only 40 experiments, the system identified six successful configurations, including one that worked at a record-low 500 watts. That could allow GRCop-42, currently difficult and expensive to print, to be made with much more widely available equipment.
